summary: Alterity Therapeutics filed a routine Form 6-K furnishing an investor-relations press release announcing that CEO David Stamler will present at the virtual Bell Potter Healthcare Conference on November 19, 2026, at 12:00 p.m. AEDT. No transaction, stake, price, premium, board recommendation, advisor, or regulatory clock is disclosed. The exhibit merely states a webcast archive will be posted on the company's investor site. This is an ordinary conference-presentation notice for a clinical-stage Australian biotech (ASX: ATH, NASDAQ: ATHE), not a special situation; no deal terms and no risk-arb angle apply.
